instruction.name: bgeu
instruction.description: Branch if unsigned rj >= rd (measured not taken).

throughput.name: 8 not-taken branches
throughput.asm: bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2' --asm 'bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0; bgeu $r4, $r5, 0'

throughput.name: 8 taken branches
throughput.asm: bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 8 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 2; addi.d $r5, $r0, 1' --asm 'bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4; bgeu $r4, $r5, 4'
throughput.notes: 8 taken branches to the next instruction take 8.00 cycles. Measured with unroll=8 to keep the static branch footprint within BTB capacity.

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput measured separately for taken and not-taken branches. Taken branches use unroll=8 to stay within BTB capacity.
